paper.finding: Section II.3 describes conversion from float filterbanks to 8-bit products using sum_fil.

observations: The quantize function clips at min/max and maps the retained range to 0..255 before unsigned-char conversion.
The 32-to-8 path derives quantmin/quantmax from a histogram of an initial qlen region and prints the limits.
The output filterbank header is written before those quantization limits are computed.
converter.scope: This pinned source explains a possible documented conversion; its exact revision, command and min/max values have not been established for the 2017 LS4 files.
